entities.summary: Brahetrolleborg is a castle about 10 kilometres north-west of Fåborg on the Danish island of Fyn. Before the Reformation, the structure was a Cistercian monastery known as Holme Abbey. After the reformation, the property was renamed Rantzausholm in 1568 before receiving its current name in 1667.
